title: How I used generative AI to shape the visual direction of my sci-fi soulslike
author: VeylorLabs
selftext:
I wanted to share some gameplay from **Protocol 73 The Zenith**.

Generative AI was only used during the early concept stage to explore ideas and help identify the right visual style for the game. The final environments, characters, animations and gameplay were created and implemented in Unreal Engine 5.
